Task: Inspect repository and inventory the dataset
Acceptance criteria: Account for 42 PDFs and 13 recordings, including four 11-page scans without text layers. Re-running preserves identifiers and originals. Record uninspected content and human annotation needs; filenames are not ground truth.
Frontend production build, API startup and liveness response pass. Clean setup is reproducible. Missing configuration is actionable; frontend assets contain no secret.

Task: Define contracts, domain rules and rubric
Acceptance criteria: Schema checks accept valid partial records and reject invalid ratings/evidence structures. Generated types match API contracts. Rubric arithmetic, unknown handling and domain/trade/cohort meanings are explicit.

Task: Implement database, revisions and private storage
Acceptance criteria: Migrations apply to an empty development database and are repeatable. History persists after restart; invalid relations/duplicate publication keys are rejected. Test storage privacy separately from database policies.
Two applicants and two cohorts prove allowed and denied access. Reject tampered/expired tokens and self-assigned privileges. Service keys remain server-side and absent from logs/assets.

All required input formats preserve intact originals; 11-page scans are accepted. Reject spoofed/oversized files and another user attachment. Duplicate requests neither leak information nor create unintended duplicate work.

Task: Implement durable workers and job progress
Acceptance criteria: Worker termination resumes checkpointed work. Duplicate delivery and queue publication failure recover with one published result. Polling is authorized and actionable. Test-handler output is never described as actual AI assessment.

Task: Build applicant submission and recording UI
Acceptance criteria: A signed-in applicant submits each supported type and sees persisted state. Refresh, upload failure and denied microphone have recovery paths. Mobile/keyboard checks pass; absent processing stages are not shown as completed.

Task: Implement translation and structured text extraction
Acceptance criteria: Real representative text/mixed-language examples persist typed records with valid sources. Unknowns stay null and changed questions do not invent facts. Invalid JSON, timeouts and source instruction injection are handled. Missing live credentials block required live verification.

Task: Implement digital PDF and handwritten scan processing
Acceptance criteria: Process complete, broken-text, mixed-language and overwritten examples plus a full 11-page Hindi scan. Sources open actual pages and uncertain handwriting is flagged. Malformed/encrypted inputs fail safely; interrupted processing resumes.

Representative Hindi, Telugu, Bengali and Odia recordings produce inspectable transcripts/records. Playback references align with actual sources. Silence, invalid/long media and provider errors stay within retry/runtime limits.

Exact arithmetic checks cover complete, partial, no-assessable-domain and conflicting cases. Reasons have valid evidence or insufficient-evidence labels. Real results survive restart; identity/social category/grammar are not scoring features.

Task: Build assessor workspace, evidence viewer and review
Acceptance criteria: All formats work from submit through source inspection/review. Correction creates a new version without losing prior evidence/actions. Stale edits and unauthorized evidence/review access are denied.

Annotated positive/hard-negative pairs yield measured Recall@5 and grounded reasons. Unauthorized candidates and own revisions never appear. Do not mix model versions/stale records or describe cosine similarity as probability/plagiarism.

One real configured lookup returns attributed context. Empty results never prove no competition; approximate locations stay labeled. Outages/ambiguity do not destroy core results or generate invented enrichment.

All four views match known aggregate fixtures. Empty/small groups, mixed rubrics and incomplete records do not generate misleading ranks. Filters/aggregates preserve cohort access boundaries and demo labels.

A real incomplete example receives useful questions and a response creates an evidence-linked revision. Repeated/stale answers do not duplicate/overwrite history. Coverage changes differ visibly from potential changes; never promise a higher score.

Tea example computes 120 x 10 x 25 = 30000 monthly revenue, never profit. Cover mixed periods, missing costs, decimal precision and ambiguous currency. Actual UI displays grounded checks with uncertainty preserved.

Multipage reports are readable with required sections and honest unavailable states. Historical reports represent their own facts. Unauthorized access is denied; exports contain no secrets or reusable private-file access.

Task: Evaluate dataset and publish actual results
Acceptance criteria: Report numerators/denominators by language/format/difficulty. No family leakage or filename-based ground truth. Measure targets in IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md and fix failures; missing required human validation/unmet release gates remain explicit blockers.

Task: Harden access, uploads and failure boundaries
Acceptance criteria: Resource access matrix passes including similarity/aggregates. Failures are bounded/actionable with no invented success or source-instruction execution. Secrets/private-data checks pass and relevant dependency findings are resolved or explicitly triaged.

Faults preserve accepted jobs and one published result per revision/pipeline. Record real hardware, workload, p50/p95 and errors; meet stated initial gates or keep required shortfalls open. Limits/budgets apply across replicas; mock throughput is separate from live AI capacity.

Clean setup builds/starts; migrations apply to empty test database. Health/shutdown/persistence checks pass and assets/images contain no secrets. CI-equivalent checks/manifests validate. This establishes deployability, not a public deployment.

Public HTTPS login-to-assessment works with real providers and restart/refresh recovery. Deployed storage privacy, redirects/CORS and errors are verified. Missing required live checks prevent completion.

Task: Run deployed acceptance and recovery checks
Acceptance criteria: Required journeys pass on recorded URL/release and blocking regressions are fixed. Recovery/rollback preserves inputs without duplicate published versions. Report actual measurements and any unverified language/provider behavior.

Task: Write final implementation and readiness handover
Acceptance criteria: Every done task has substantive report/passed evidence; blocked work stays visible. Setup and actual deployment/evidence are discoverable. Distinguish implemented/tested/deployed/future work; no readiness or scale claim exceeds evidence.
